# graviteeam_theme (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM Theme (branding, colors, custom CSS)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_theme" "example" {
  domain_id                  = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  primary_button_color_hex   = "#1a73e8"
  secondary_button_color_hex = "#e8f0fe"
  primary_text_color_hex     = "#202124"
  secondary_text_color_hex   = "#5f6368"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain this theme belongs to

### Optional

- `css` (String) Custom CSS to apply to login pages
- `favicon_url` (String) URL of the favicon
- `logo_url` (String) URL of the logo image
- `logo_width` (Number) Width of the logo in pixels
- `primary_button_color_hex` (String) Primary button color in hex format (e.g. #4CAF50)
- `primary_text_color_hex` (String) Primary text color in hex format
- `secondary_button_color_hex` (String) Secondary button color in hex format
- `secondary_text_color_hex` (String) Secondary text color in hex format

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the theme
